summary: Skyward Specialty Insurance Group, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing that its Board of Directors approved an expansion of the share repurchase program, increasing the authorization from $50 million to up to $100 million. No specific price per share, premium, or timeline was provided. Repurchases may occur via open market or private transactions, with discretion on timing and amount. The program is not binding and can be modified or terminated at any time. This is a capital return event but with limited terms disclosed; watch for actual repurchase activity and potential impact on share price.
